method: all eight captured on ONE deployed SHA through the real customer journey, then diagnosed OFFLINE from the artifacts. Zero live analyses were spent on diagnosis.

mechanical_audit.note: case A and the archetype fallback both hold: 'Who's the real competitor?' is identical on 0 of 28 pairs.

instrument_corrections.error: chrome truncation applied to a whole ROUTE
instrument_corrections.symptom: Meta/Amazon slides and full both scored 1.000
instrument_corrections.cause: a 6,333-character page was truncated at its first boilerplate marker, comparing 454 characters of opening banner
instrument_corrections.lesson: a route is not an answer; strip chrome, do not truncate

instrument_corrections.error: the bare word 'next' used as a chrome marker
instrument_corrections.symptom: 'What should we measure next?' identical on 28 of 28
instrument_corrections.cause: the QUESTION contains 'next', so every answer truncated to 'what should we measure ' — an instrument that had stopped measuring
instrument_corrections.lesson: a bare common word is not a marker; verify the instrument hardest when it produces the most dramatic number

qa_collapse_pairs_of_10.shared: BOTH REFUSED — not a shared pattern
nothing — the floor, and the control

root_cause.finding: EIGHT OF THE TEN board questions this programme asks reached no intent in the Q&A router. They fell to the strategic catch-all, which answers from the matched pattern's own text.
root_cause.evidence: the two questions that DID route — 'What's the biggest risk?' and 'Who's the real competitor?' — are the two that did not collapse; competitor is 0 of 28
two_of_the_misses_were_trivial: the falsifier marker required 'proveS this wrong'; the board asks 'What WOULD prove this wrong?' — one character
the monitoring marker knew 'monitor next' and not 'measure next'
root_cause.the_refusal: Eli Lilly and Walmart answered eight questions with 'I am not going to give you a strategic read on this company' while their own introductions rendered 'Our read: Bounded' and a real central question. The trailing clause — 'the same reason the summary above withheld it' — cites a refusal no longer being made.
root_cause.one_gap: one router gap produced two collapse clusters and one cross-surface contradiction, which had been treated as three separate defects

repair.shape: cluster-first: the router once, not three renderers
changes: all ten board questions now route
four intents added: why_now, market_belief, weakest_assumption, impossible_hypothesis
recommendation hears management and the board
a routed answer still carries its grounding — the early return had started skipping it
guards: no two intents may declare one field
no marker may be a bare common word
every intent needs markers, a field and an honest absent sentence
repair.scope: closes the catch-all half (within-company repetition and the Lilly/Walmart refusal); does NOT close the shared-pattern half

still_open.successor_defect: two companies sharing a top pattern still share the pattern's own text where a question routes to a field the decision fills from it. The router repair removes the CATCH-ALL half; composition from the company's own evidence is the other.
still_open.measured_by_the_other_session: selection cannot close it: 2 options in 11 of 12 patterns, ONE gap in 11 of 12, and a lexical selector scored 0.000 on five of six fields because the scaffold speaks strategic vocabulary and the evidence speaks company vocabulary

correction_to_this_documents_own_first_c.what_was_claimed: that the router gap produced everything we had been treating as three defects
correction_to_this_documents_own_first_c.what_is_true: The router gap is real and is confirmed by the captures: measured with each answer's echoed QUESTION removed, every company gave only 5 or 6 DISTINCT answers out of ten, and the repeated sentence is the catch-all — 'yes, on balance the evidence supports that committing capital to capacity...' for Caterpillar, Exxon and NVIDIA; 'running separately-reported businesses...' for Amazon and Meta; 'there is not enough public evidence to answer that confidently' for Lilly and Walmart. So 4 to 6 of the ten questions per company returned ONE repeated sentence.
correction_to_this_documents_own_first_c.what_the_repair_does_not_do: It does NOT separate two companies that share a pattern. Measured offline against the repaired router: two same-pattern companies still answer identically, because every field the ten questions now route to is itself pattern-derived. Routing changes WHICH field is read, not whose text fills it.
correction_to_this_documents_own_first_c.so: the router gap explains the MAGNITUDE of the collapse and the refusal; the successor defect — shared pattern, shared reading — is untouched and remains the open item
correction_to_this_documents_own_first_c.how_this_was_caught: by measuring the repair offline before spending a canary run on it, rather than by asserting it from the shape of the fix
correction_to_this_documents_own_first_c.an_instrument_error_inside_the_correctio: the first within-company measurement said 10/10 distinct for every company, which would have meant no catch-all at all. Each answer page ECHOES its own question, so the questions were differentiating the answers. Stripping the echo gave 5-6/10. Third instrument error of the session, same shape as the other two: the number looked clean and the instrument had stopped measuring the thing.

canary_reproof_on_afeba08.why: the preview lost the run between the six steps and the Q&A POSTs, on 2 of 2 attempted canaries, with NO deploy happening in the window. Routes captured fine (5-6k chars each); every answer came back 'This session does not have an analysis with that id'.
canary_reproof_on_afeba08.what_this_is_not: a product regression. The first measurement of the re-run reported within-company distinctness collapsing 6 -> 1 and cross-company 0 -> 10 identical, which would have been a catastrophic regression. It was forty copies of one error page. Caught by reading the answers before reporting the number — the fourth instrument failure of the session and the most alarming.
canary_reproof_on_afeba08.harness_repaired: the capture now NAMES a lost run (RUN_LOST) instead of storing error pages as answers, and the audit refuses to load them. Q&A was also moved ahead of the low-value routes to narrow the window.
canary_reproof_on_afeba08.a_real_finding_inside_it: the earlier eight-company wave on fdbfe77 captured 80 of 80 answers, and this window lost 2 of 2 — so it is intermittent, not constant. A guest who reads step 1 and then asks a question can be told the analysis is not available. That is customer-facing and is NOT explained by deploys, because none happened here.
canary_reproof_on_afeba08.quota: about 14-16 live analyses spent across both sessions

what_is_established_about_the_router_rep.offline: it removes the catch-all, which was returning ONE repeated sentence for 4-6 of the ten questions per company
what_is_established_about_the_router_rep.offline_limit: it does NOT separate two same-pattern companies; every field the ten questions route to is itself pattern-derived
